title: Language settings
help.registry: Deploy the UI catalog before enabling a language. Public and administration languages also need the UI enabled.
status.pending: Some language settings are not published.
status.published: The saved language settings are published.
notices.saved: Language settings and UI translations saved as drafts. Publish to activate them.
notices.published: Language settings and UI catalogs published.
add.title: Register a language
add.help: New locales are registered disabled. Deploy resources/locales/LOCALE/common.json and its catalog files before enabling UI, public pages, or administration.
add.code: BCP 47 language code (for example, de or pt-BR)
add.fallbacks_help: Languages are tried in the order you select them.
errors.new_code_required: Enter the new locale code before saving.
errors.new_fields_required: The new locale URL prefix, native name, and fallback locales are required.
errors.invalid: Invalid language settings. Check the default language and fallback order.
errors.dependency: Public and administration languages also need the UI enabled.
errors.catalog_missing: Deploy the UI catalog for this language first.
errors.publication_failed: Publishing failed. Saved settings are retained. Check the storage directory and publish again.
errors.catalog_history_invalid: This catalog history entry is invalid or no longer available.
errors.catalog_history_bundle_missing: The immutable UI catalog bundle for this history entry is missing.
errors.catalog_history_current: This catalog revision is already active.
errors.translation_locale_invalid: Choose a registered target language other than the source language.
errors.translation_catalog_input_invalid: The translation is empty or invalid.
errors.translation_source_changed: The source message changed. Reload the catalog before saving.
errors.translation_message_invalid: The message has invalid ICU syntax or placeholders.
errors.translation_catalog_invalid: A UI catalog JSON file or ICU message is invalid. Fix the catalog before publishing.
errors.translation_package_invalid: The catalog package or one of its messages is invalid.
errors.translation_package_mismatch: The selected language or group does not match the package.
catalog.title: UI translation catalog
catalog.help: Export JSON, edit the value fields offline, then import and publish. Import checks the source text, placeholders and version conflicts.
catalog.override_cleared: Translation override cleared; publish language settings to activate the catalog fallback.
catalog.saved: Translation saved as a draft; publish language settings to activate it.
catalog.stale: Source changed; this override is not applied.
catalog.imported: Imported {count} translations, removed {removed} overrides, skipped {skipped} empty entries.
history.title: Previous language package
history.help: Each entry is an immutable published UI catalog snapshot for the current language registry. Rolling back switches the active catalog revision and keeps current language settings.
history.confirm: Switch the active UI catalog to this earlier revision?
history.rolled_back: The active UI catalog has been rolled back.
migration.title: Migration audit
migration.help: Compare retained legacy fields with localized records. SHA-256 values summarize fields; difference details show record IDs and hashes, never content.
migration.details_truncated: Only the first 100 differences are shown.
coverage.title: Business content coverage
coverage.help: Articles, products, announcements, and current policies count published translations. Homepage, navigation, and categories count saved translations.
